headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds On as Fishermans Row Flags Turn Again
war_summary: Three hours on, Fishermans Row's unanimous Colonial hold is broken: Wardens have regained two works, six fly Colonial colors, one lies as no-man's-land, and the region posts forty-six flag events in the day, its latest logged at this edition's very minute. Weathered Expanse remains the costliest field, with roughly 13,600 Colonial and 16,500 Warden losses in a day around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest; the hourly exchange has slackened, and the works stand five Warden to four Colonial. Stlican Shelf keeps churning, thirty-five events behind a seven-to-two Warden count. Mooring County's contest about The Wind Hills cools but continues, all twelve works in Warden keeping. Linn of Mercy is busy, its casualty rates accelerating about Lathair, ten Colonial works to one. Stonecradle stays unsettled at five to four. Callahans Passage, last edition's lead, has gone comparatively still, its ten works in Warden hands after Crumbling Post's convulsions. The Nevish Line and the Dead Lands remain silent. Day 278; no victor declared.
